- claim-2: This bounded computation does not by itself establish any unchecked all-parameter or parent-theorem claim.
## Strategy
For the stipulated interval/Pieri model, set
\[
\mathcal C_D=\{\lambda:(2,2)\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(4^4),\ |\lambda|=D\}.
\]
The complete degree-\(D\) presentation is
\[
Q_D=\mathbb Z^{\mathcal C_D}/\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Z}(R_D),
\]
where rows of \(R_D\) are indexed by \((t,\mu)\), \(1\le t\le4\), \(\mu\in\mathcal C_{D-t}\), columns by \(\lambda\in\mathcal C_D\), and
\[
(R_D)_{(t,\mu),\lambda}=
\begin{cases}
1,&\lambda/\mu\text{ is a horizontal }t\text{-strip},\\
0,&\text{otherwise}.
\end{cases}
\]
The accepted \(q=4\) result gives \(A_+=(h_1,h_2,h_3,h_4)\), so these are the intended complete positive-degree multiplication rows, conditional on the interval presentation.

The artifact-reported Smith data are:

\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}
D&|\mathcal C_D|&\operatorname{rank}R_D&
\operatorname{SNF}_{\ne0}(R_D)&\operatorname{rank}Q_D\\\hline
4&1&0&()&1\\
5&2&1&(1)&1\\
6&5&3&(1,1,1)&2\\
7&6&5&(1^5)&1\\
8&8&7&(1^7)&1\\
9&7&7&(1^7)&0\\
10&7&7&(1^7)&0\\
11&5&5&(1^5)&0\\
12&5&5&(1^5)&0\\
13&3&3&(1^3)&0\\
14&2&2&(1,1)&0\\
15&1&1&(1)&0\\
16&1&1&(1)&0
\end{array}
\]
Thus this computed model has \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\), torsion-free.

The expected specializations of the two six-element families are
\[
\{s_{22},s_{32},s_{33},s_{42},s_{43},s_{44}\},
\qquad
\{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\}.
\]
If the source formulas and generation statements identify these as the two proposed families, each maps to a six-element spanning family of \(\mathbb Z^6\), hence to a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis.

## Gaps
The computation claim is marked **unsupported** in the evidence ledger. The record does not supply an exact source locator specializing the two source families to the displayed partitions, nor independently grounds the interval Schur presentation
\[
J_{2,2}=\bigoplus_{(2,2)\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(4^4)}\mathbb Zs_\lambda.
\]
Consequently, the requested target is **not established in the currently validated record**, despite the conditional finite calculation above.

## Next
Supply exact source-grounded formulas for both specialized families and the interval presentation, and validate the cited artifact’s complete row output. These additions would make the displayed Smith certificate sufficient to conclude, only for \(i=j=p=c=2\), that both families map to integral bases of \(Q\).
